verdict.rationale: SumUp documents Virtual Solo, a simulated Solo card reader that works with a sandbox merchant account. It lets developers test the Cloud API pairing and checkout flow before switching to a physical reader, which directly covers simulated-reader testing for one in-person path. The evidence does not show equivalent simulation for the Reader SDKs (Bluetooth readers), Tap to Pay, or Payment Switch, and the test-card set is documented only for online payments. missing for 10: simulated reader or test environment for the Reader SDK, Tap to Pay and Payment Switch paths, in-person test cards or outcome simulation (declines, errors), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later
Virtual Solo simulates a Solo card reader so you can test pairing and checkout flows.
Prepare a merchant account, device, and integration for testing.
